author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks,

This is my latest map called quads. This is a unique build, some may like it others may not. It has a controlled item and resource set , so although there are enough items, no one will have full enchanted diamond and full inventory of useless things. I hope you like it. I have it on my realm if ya want to see it there devs.

Pics: http://imgur.com/a/bBcHi

→ Too thin. Do you think the center of the map could be improved to be thicker?
→ Too small. Could the size be improved to be larger?
→ Too basic. Could the middle be improved to look more appealing?
→ Too limited. Could it be expanded to have more room?
